name: Innai Kansen Gozen 3 Ji no Shujutsushitsu
original_name: 淫内感染　午前3時の手術室
source:
Main character is a physician working for a private medical facility. Through big changes in staff he obtains position of the president with an absolute power. Only beautiful women continue to work in the hospital as slaves while others get disposed of as crude materials...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名在私立医疗机构工作的医生。医院人员经历大规模变动后，他登上院长之位，获得了绝对权力。只有美丽的女人能以奴隶的身份继续在医院工作，其余人则会被当作粗劣材料处理掉…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
